commands.name: read_radar_tracks
commands.who: ComputerCraft program on a computer wired to the dish
commands.what: load the current Create Radar track list from a dish that is not on the gun bearing
commands.when: a Create Radar dish is attached; each time a caller needs this tick's tracks
commands.where: Amazeballs world, ComputerCraft peripheral wrap on that computer
commands.why: Create Radar yaw and pitch controllers drive cannon mounts, not Simulated swivel bearings, so this program must read tracks itself
commands.call: Lua bearing_turret.read_radar_tracks(opts); opts omitted, nil, or a table whose keys are a subset of inputs

inputs.radar_name: optional string on the Lua opts table; rotating dish or plane radar peripheral name; omit key, nil, or empty string to discover
inputs.monitor_name: optional string on the Lua opts table; Create Radar monitor peripheral name; omit key, nil, or empty string to discover; name only a monitor by setting this key and omitting radar_name

commands.name: read_swivel_bearing_angle
commands.who: ComputerCraft program wired to a Simulated swivel bearing
commands.what: read the stored servo target in degrees via getTargetAngle; visual or physics orientation is out of reach
commands.where: Amazeballs world, native swivel ComputerCraft wrap
commands.why: closed-loop rotate needs the angle; native wrap is read-only
commands.call: Lua bearing_turret.read_swivel_bearing_angle(opts); opts omitted, nil, or a table whose keys are a subset of inputs; success is one Lua number in degrees

inputs.bearing_name: optional string on the Lua opts table; swivel_bearing peripheral name; omit key, nil, or empty string to discover

outputs.angle_degrees: one Lua number; stored servo target; bearing-local degrees about FACING; remainder negatives from Java %= 360 are allowed; the number already includes Simulated's FACING-negative kinetic speed flip; callers must not re-apply that flip; after disassemble and before the next writer, the number is 0; still one Lua number

commands.name: set_electric_motor_speed
commands.who: ComputerCraft program wired to a Create Crafts and Additions electric motor
commands.what: set that motor's commanded speed; skip setSpeed when getSpeed already equals rpm; getSpeed is commanded motorSpeed; an out-of-range rpm never equals getSpeed after Java clamp so those calls always write; unpowered or redstone-POWERED motors still succeed and still skip
commands.where: Amazeballs world, kinetic network on the bearing
commands.why: bearings turn from kinetic input; this is the write primitive; native swivel wrap cannot set angle
commands.call: Lua bearing_turret.set_electric_motor_speed(opts); opts is a table; success is no return values

inputs.motor_name: optional string on the Lua opts table; electric_motor peripheral name; omit key, nil, or empty string to discover
inputs.rpm: required finite Lua number; passed to setSpeed as a number; Java clamps to configured RPM range
